001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import gnu.trove.list.array.TIntArrayList;
004import java.util.Arrays;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.Map;
007import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.Card;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PartialSolutionAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
017
018    @Override
019    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
020        Map<AstClafer, PartialSolution> partialSolutionMap = new HashMap<>();
021
022        analyze(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), analysis, partialSolutionMap);
023        analyze(analysis.getModel().getAbstractRoot(), analysis, partialSolutionMap);
024
025        return analysis.setPartialSolutionMap(partialSolutionMap);
026    }
027
028    private static void analyze(
029            AstAbstractClafer clafer,
030            Analysis analysis,
031            Map<AstClafer, PartialSolution> partialSolutionMap) {
032        Card globalCard = analysis.getGlobalCard(clafer);
033        boolean[] solution = new boolean[analysis.getScope(clafer)];
034        int[][] parents = new int[globalCard.getHigh()][];
035        for (AstClafer sub : clafer.getSubs()) {
036            int offset = analysis.getOffsets(clafer).getOffset(sub);
037
038            PartialSolution partialSubSolution = partialSolutionMap.get(sub);
039            // This is possible for partialSubSolution to be null if a child of an abstract
040            // extends the abstract. Assume the worst possible case by assuming it is empty.
041            if (partialSubSolution != null) {
042                System.arraycopy(partialSubSolution.getSolution(), 0, solution, offset, partialSubSolution.size());
043            }
044        }
045        partialSolutionMap.put(clafer, new PartialSolution(solution, parents));
046
047        for (AstConcreteClafer child : clafer.getChildren()) {
048            analyze(child, analysis, partialSolutionMap);
049        }
050        for (AstAbstractClafer child : clafer.getAbstractChildren()) {
051            analyze(child, analysis, partialSolutionMap);
052        }
053    }
054
055    private static void analyze(
056            AstConcreteClafer clafer,
057            Analysis analysis,
058            Map<AstClafer, PartialSolution> partialSolutionMap) {
059        Card globalCard = analysis.getGlobalCard(clafer);
060        Format format = analysis.getFormat(clafer);
061
062        boolean[] solution = new boolean[analysis.getScope(clafer)];
063        TIntArrayList[] parents = new TIntArrayList[globalCard.getHigh()];
064        for (int i = 0; i < parents.length; i++) {
065            parents[i] = new TIntArrayList();
066        }
067
068        Card card = analysis.getCard(clafer);
069        int lowCard = card.getLow();
070        int highCard = card.getHigh();
071        if (clafer.hasParent()) {
072            PartialSolution partialParentSolution = partialSolutionMap.get(clafer.getParent());
073            switch (format) {
074                case LowGroup:
075                    Arrays.fill(solution, 0, globalCard.getLow(), true);
076                    int low = 0;
077                    int high = highCard;
078                    for (int i = 0; i < partialParentSolution.size(); i++) {
079                        for (int j = low; j < high && j < parents.length; j++) {
080                            parents[j].add(i);
081                        }
082                        if (partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
083                            low += lowCard;
084                        }
085                        high += highCard;
086                    }
087                    break;
088                case ParentGroup:
089                    assert lowCard == highCard;
090                    for (int i = 0; i < partialParentSolution.size(); i++) {
091                        for (int j = 0; j < lowCard; j++) {
092                            solution[i * lowCard + j] = partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i);
093                            parents[i * lowCard + j].add(i);
094                        }
095                    }
096                    break;
097                default:
098                    throw new AnalysisException();
099            }
100        } else {
101            Arrays.fill(solution, 0, lowCard, true);
102            Arrays.fill(parents, new TIntArrayList(new int[]{0}));
103        }
104        partialSolutionMap.put(clafer, new PartialSolution(solution, toArray(parents)));
105
106        for (AstConcreteClafer child : clafer.getChildren()) {
107            analyze(child, analysis, partialSolutionMap);
108        }
109        // after the concrete children, which include their subs
110        for (AstAbstractClafer child : clafer.getAbstractChildren()) {
111            analyze(child, analysis, partialSolutionMap);
112        }
113    }
114
115    private static int[][] toArray(TIntArrayList[] list) {
116        int[][] array = new int[list.length][];
117        for (int i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
118            array[i] = list[i].toArray();
119        }
120        return array;
121    }
122}
